title: Break your sequence into explicit beats (e.g., approach → reveal → player →…
content:
Break your sequence into explicit beats (e.g., approach → reveal → player → ball → crowd → goal) and generate/direct each shot beat-by-beat in Seedance.  
For each beat, specify timing, camera movement, and on-screen action to control the sequence shot by shot.
tips:
Break your sequence into explicit beats (e.g., approach → reveal → player → ball → crowd → goal) and generate/direct each shot beat-by-beat in Seedance.  
For each beat, specify timing, camera movement, and on-screen action to control the sequence shot by shot.

es.content:
Divide tu secuencia en momentos explícitos (por ejemplo, approach → reveal → player → ball → crowd → goal) y genera/dirige cada toma paso a paso en Seedance.  
Para cada momento, especifica el tiempo, el movimiento de cámara y la acción en pantalla para controlar la secuencia toma por toma.

fr.content:
Divisez votre séquence en moments explicites (par exemple, approach → reveal → player → ball → crowd → goal) et générez/dirigez chaque prise moment par moment dans Seedance.  
Pour chaque moment, spécifiez le timing, le mouvement de la caméra et l'action à l'écran pour contrôler la séquence plan par plan.

ja.content:
シーケンスを明確なビートに分けてください（例：アプローチ → リビール → プレイヤー → ボール → 観客 → ゴール）し、Seedanceで各ショットをビートごとに生成/指示します。  
各ビートごとにタイミング、カメラの動き、画面上のアクションを指定して、ショットごとにシーケンスをコントロールします。

ko.content:
시퀀스를 명확한 비트로 나누세요 (예: 접근 → 공개 → 플레이어 → 공 → 관중 → 골) 그리고 Seedance에서 각 샷을 비트별로 생성/연출하세요.  
각 비트마다 타이밍, 카메라 움직임, 화면상의 동작을 지정하여 시퀀스를 샷별로 제어하세요.

pt.content:
Divida sua sequência em momentos explícitos (por exemplo, approach → reveal → player → ball → crowd → goal) e gere/dirija cada tomada momento a momento no Seedance.  
Para cada momento, especifique o tempo, o movimento da câmera e a ação na tela para controlar a sequência tomada por tomada.

zh.content:
将你的序列分解为明确的节拍（例如，approach → reveal → player → ball → crowd → goal），并在Seedance中逐拍生成/指导每个镜头。  
对于每个节拍，指定时间、镜头运动和屏幕上的动作，以逐镜头控制序列。
